Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
James, I'll let you know after origins next year.
Girls was never edge explosion imbued level nonsense, but girls is still viable and annoying in my book without anthelios and Lilith's Blessing. To be fair, imbued table poison is still viable without edge explosion and memories of mortality, but with both decks you play an annoying slow dying deck with the table not liking you.

Nana and Anson will always be able to do other stuff than spam Ashurs and liquidation, so maybe if popularity wanes on girls we get to see interesting mmpa based combat again? I know my Anson second trad n guns is safer the less AAA decks seem easy to win with. I hate bans, I favor erratta and want physical cards printed.

Didn't I just see a Nephundi gargoyles deck win in Brazil? Anthelios was a good booster for "requires X Gehenna cards in play" stuff, so I'm still trying to gauge the impact there.
